raw_text: While we understand the importance of supporting a small team to build, maintain, and continuously improve the materials customer AI agents need to use our services it's unclear that the need justifies the cost. We're opting to divert the previously allocated resources to areas where there is clear need for them. Until such a time as we hear a clearer path to resolving the feedback we get from our customers we've chosen to set this intiative aside for now.
